translation.title: Mucopolysaccharide Polysulfate Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for symptoms caused by varicose veins - such as pain, a feeling of heaviness and swelling of the lower legs - and for blunt injuries from accidents or sports, such as hematomas (blood bruises), bruises, sprains, swelling, and pain of the muscles and ligaments.
translation.usage: For adults, apply about 3 to 5 cm at a time, several times a day, to the affected area.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have or have had a hypersensitivity reaction to heparin, if you have a constitution prone to bleeding, if you have heparin-induced thrombocytopenia, or for children. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are or have had hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to propylene glycol. This medicine is for external use only - do not take it by mouth. Do not use it on wounds, mucous membranes, around the eyes, or on suppurative (pus-forming) infected areas. Be careful not to get it in your eyes; if it does get in, rinse immediately with water. Do not apply it over too wide an area. Take care that the wound is not exposed to the sun's heat or light. Do not use an occlusive (airtight) dressing. Adverse reactions may occur - local allergic reactions; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at 15 to 25°C and keep out of reach of children.
